strings.assuming_strapped: Assuming SELECT is strapped low. If 'audio record' shows the signal in the other slot, re-run with 'right'.
strings.bclk_out_of_spec: Bit clock is %.3f MHz, outside the SPH0645's %.3f-%.3f MHz
strings.bclk_out_of_spec_note: In spec is %d-%d Hz; the part may still respond, but out of specification.
strings.bclk_too_slow: Bit clock is %.3f MHz, below the 0.9 MHz at which the SPH0645 goes to sleep
strings.bclk_too_slow_note: Below %d Hz the part sleeps and reads as a dead microphone; it needs %d-%d Hz. Re-run 'audio bus ... rate 48000 bits 32'.
strings.group.help: Knowles SPH0645LM4H-B I2S MEMS microphone (no control bus)
strings.init.help: Attach the microphone and check the bus suits it
strings.needs_32_bit: The SPH0645 needs 32-bit slots and the bus is set to 16
strings.needs_32_bit_note: Its oversampling ratio is fixed at 64, so the frame must be two 32-bit slots. Re-run 'audio bus ... bits 32'.
strings.next_step: Run 'audio record' to see what it hears.
strings.not_attached: SPH0645 is not attached. Run 'audio-sph0645 init [left|right] [sel <pin>]'.
strings.pdm_mode_note: Open the bus with a receive line instead: 'audio bus <bclk> <ws> <dout> din <pin> bits 32'.
strings.pdm_mode_wrong: The SPH0645 is an I2S part, but the receiver is in PDM mode
strings.sel_invalid: SELECT must be an output-capable pin, not '%s'
strings.status.help: Show the slot, clock and what the part guarantees
strings.status_mirror_left: The left slot should be near silence; mirroring means no pull-down on the data line
strings.status_mirror_right: The right slot should be near silence; mirroring means no pull-down on the data line
strings.status_no_bus: No control bus, so nothing here confirms the part is really an SPH0645
strings.status_precision: 24-bit words, 18 bits of real precision, LSBs zero
strings.status_select_strapped: ; SELECT is strapped on the board, not driven from here
strings.status_spl: %.0f dB SPL reads %.0f dBFS; speech at arm's length is about %.0f dBFS
